dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000recz](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000recz) Magnitude 5.7 earthquake at 571.146 depth occurred on Oct 02 2025 29 km W of El Hoyo, Argentina. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -27.0636 longitude -63.5228. It impacted 7706 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
